findings.description: The callback rebinds the enclosing `package_name` via `nonlocal` to the resolved distribution name. This mutates decorator-level state from inside the callback.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `--version` is invoked, and the detected name only resolves as an import name (e.g. `PIL`). The callback sets `package_name` to the distribution name (`Pillow`), so the later `%(package)s` in the message shows `Pillow` rather than the name the user passed. Impact is limited to the message text, and that may be intended.
